sources.title: RKB109/rag-evaluation-lab-20260819-model · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: RAG Evaluation Lab Baseline Model Model Description This repository contains a small, transparent prototype model for RAG systems often ship without a stable regression set or failure taxonomy. The model combines per-label token weights with IDF-weighted evidence retrieval.

sources.title: GitHub - gratycodes/rag-evaluation-lab
sources.snippet: RAG Evaluation Lab is an AI engineering showcase for measuring retrieval-augmented generation quality. It focuses on evaluation design, dataset structure, retrieval metrics, answer faithfulness checks, and repeatable experiments.

sources.title: ramirez-ai-labs/rag-evaluation-lab - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the RAG Evaluation Lab! This project is a simple, beginner-friendly introduction to how we evaluate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems—the same technique used in modern AI assistants, documentation bots, and advanced search tools.

sources.title: A complete guide to RAG evaluation: metrics, testing and best practices
sources.snippet: This guide breaks down how to evaluate and test RAG systems. You'll learn how to evaluate retrieval and generation quality, build test sets with synthetic data, run experiments, and monitor in production.
